description_en: Queries the name of the product to which shared devices belong in a sharing task based on the ProductKey
description_zh: 调用该接口根据产品ProductKey查询分享任务中共享设备所属产品的名称
name: QueryShareProductNameByProductKey

parameters.help_en:
The share code of the sharing task.

For information about the share code of a sharing task, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607661.html
parameters.help_zh:
分享任务的分享码。

分享任务的分享码信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607661.html
parameters.name: share_task_code

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the shared devices belong
parameters.name: product_key
